verdicts.tldr: the sentinel that promises to catch js/index.js losing its /public/js/controller- prefix counts /public/ across the whole asset tree, so any other asset URL keeps it silent
verdicts.details: copyTree (crawl.go:565-575) returns strings.Count(b, "/public/") summed over every .js and .css it copies; Write warns only on that total being zero (crawl.go:314-316), with a message naming js/index.js and the controller prefix. Measured on the shipped tree: total=1, perFile=map[js/index.js:1], so the sentinel equals the invariant by coincidence today. A fixture where index.js's specifier is rewritten to a bare "./js/controller-" and main.css gains url(/public/imgs/gnoland.svg) gives rewrites=1 and no warning. The n==0 branch also has no return: Write reports success either way, so even the coincidental warning cannot redden the job. Fix: count the string the comment names in the file it names, and return an error rather than a stderr line.
verdicts.evidence: go test -run TestJudge180 -v . in misc/gnopreview at ecf7af0: TestJudge180ShippedTreeHasOneOccurrence logs 'total=1 perFile=map[js/index.js:1]' PASS; TestJudge180SentinelMissesControllerPrefixLoss logs 'copyTree rewrites=1' with the controller prefix removed, FAIL. Read: crawl.go:314 'if n == 0 { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, ...) }' has no return and Write ends on 'return c.writePages(dir)'. Merge base has no misc/gnopreview at all (ls: No such file or directory), so the diff introduces it.
verdicts.verify_by: grep -rc '/public/' gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/public/js/index.js gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/public/main.css (1 and 0, so the whole-tree count is index.js's count); then make the guard count '/public/js/controller-' in js/index.js and re-run cd misc/gnopreview && go test ./... | grep -rc '/public/' gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/public --include='*.js' --include='*.css' (one file, count 1, js/index.js); then read copyTree line 573: `if n := strings.Count(string(b), "/public/"); n > 0 { rewrites += n }` - the counter is not scoped to the controller prefix the comment names. | Count the literals in the shipped tree (grep -rc '/public/' gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/public), then read crawl.go:314-316: the n==0 branch has no return and no error.

verdicts.tldr: seedSet and its half of the link filter admit nothing the queue does not already hold; Run 46 -> 41 lines with both gone
verdicts.details: Run() seeds `queue` with every element of c.Seeds() before the loop (crawl.go:117) and marks each dequeued URL visited unconditionally at crawl.go:125, the only paths out of the loop body being `continue` after that mark or the page-cap `return`. So a link equal to a seed is always either already visited, which the first half of the filter rejects, or still in the queue, which makes the append a duplicate the visited check drops. The map, its four-line build and the `seedSet[link] ||` term encode a rule the queue already enforces, and the next reader of the link filter has to re-derive that they are the same rule. Fix: `queue := c.Seeds()` and `if !visited[link] && c.inScope(link)`.
verdicts.evidence: Reran the finder's fixture from the file at ecf7af0: 'captured [/r/x /r/x/y /r/x/y$help /r/x/y$source]', --- PASS: TestSeedSetAdmitsNothingNew. Applied the rewrite (2 insertions, 7 deletions to crawl.go), reran: identical 'captured [/r/x /r/x/y /r/x/y$help /r/x/y$source]', PASS; go vet . silent, go test . 'ok github.com/gnolang/gno/misc/gnopreview 0.006s', gofmt clean on crawl.go. Run() body 46 lines at head, 41 rewritten. Merge base has no misc/gnopreview.
verdicts.verify_by: delete :112-115, replace `queue := append([]string(nil), seeds...)` with `queue := c.Seeds()` and the filter with `if !visited[link] && c.inScope(link)`; cd misc/gnopreview && go test ./... , plus tests/b2-refactor-r2-seedset-dead.go, which crawls a realm page linking to the seeded /r/x and pins the captured set on head and on the rewrite

verdicts.tldr: a gnodev that dies mid-crawl is invisible: Run() returns nil, render() publishes a partial snapshot and the job is green
verdicts.details: The died channel is read only inside waitReady's select (crawl.go, waitReady loop), which stops once the probe answers; after main.go:131 nothing reads it. A gnodev that dies during the crawl therefore reaches nobody: Crawler.Run prints '! <url>: connection refused' per URL at crawl.go:129-131 and continues, and returns nil, so render() goes on to Write, Index, Screenshot and Comment and exits 0. The reviewer gets a snapshot missing most of its realms with a sticky comment linking every realm in the plan, including the ones that have no page, and nothing in the job says so. Separately, gnodev is started with SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true} at main.go:190 and the module imports os/signal nowhere, so a Ctrl-C reaches gnopreview alone, its `defer stop()` never runs, and gnodev survives holding -port and -port+10000. Fix: keep reading died past readiness and fail the render on it, and install a signal handler that runs stop().
verdicts.evidence: Reran the finder's fixture from the file at ecf7af0, go test -run ClaimsR2 -v . in misc/gnopreview: '✓ /r/demo/a', then '! /r/demo/b: ... connect: connection refused' and the same for /r/demo/c, 'seeds=3 captured=1 err=<nil>', 'DEFECT: Run() == nil after the node died; 1 of 3 realm pages captured'. Read for the orphan half: main.go:190 `cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true}`, and grep -rn 'os/signal|signal.Notify|NotifyContext' over misc/gnopreview returns nothing. Merge base has no misc/gnopreview, so both are the diff's.
verdicts.verify_by: go test -run ClaimsR2 -v ./misc/gnopreview with tests/b3-claims-r2-node-death-mid-crawl.go copied to misc/gnopreview/: the server answers the first seed then closes its listener; expect Run() to report the dead node, observe err=<nil> | tests/b3-lines-r2-gnodev-orphan.sh: start the built gnopreview under setsid with a stub gnodev, send SIGINT to its process group, count survivors
